name: Living Nexus
description: Read-only Living Nexus Portable Witness discovery channel. Discovers eligible public Living Nexus Works through the revocable Portable Witness gateway. Living Nexus remains the source of truth for WIDs, attribution, publication, revocation, and media authorization.
overview: Read-only Living Nexus Portable Witness discovery channel.

versions.changelog: Initial public release of the read-only Living Nexus Portable Witness discovery channel.
